stem: Which statement describes the primary objection of opponents to the Sedition Act?

options.label: A
options.text: The Sedition Act blocked ratification of the Treaty of Versailles.

options.label: B
options.text: The Sedition Act did not prohibit membership in the Socialist Party.

options.label: C
options.text: The Sedition Act did not fine offenders enough to satisfy the Progressive Party.

options.label: D
options.text: The Sedition Act violated civil liberties guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution.
